answer: Cap each identity at one live session by requiring a lease token that is stolen the moment a second connection appears in the same epoch, and a stolen lease voids the prior holder's ripple for 3 epochs. A farm must therefore run heads serially: 500 puppets take 500 turns, so the ledge of parallel fakes collapses into a trellis of queued waiting, and the cost per vote stays linear in real time.
